items.title: Citigroup (C) Launches Fresh Debt Offerings, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
items.summary: Citigroup (C) has just launched a fresh wave of fixed income offerings, including new senior unsecured notes with fixed coupons ranging from 4.70% to 6.20%. This funding activity gives stock investors extra context on Citi’s capital structure. Citigroup’s share price has recently eased, with a 1 day share price return of a 0.66% decline, following a 7 day share price return of 2.32% and a 90 day share price return of 5.39%. items.title: Citi opens upside catalyst watches on BMW and Forvia
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi has opened positive catalyst watches on BMW (ETR: BMWG) and Forvia (EPA: FRVIA), arguing that depressed sentiment across European autos has left both names with attractive tactical setups.

items.summary: SEC subpoenas Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Citigroup and Bank of America over margin lending to hedge fund Situational Awareness, which suffered a 67% drawdown amid an AI stock sell-off.

items.title: Citi cuts Abercrombie rating after stock surge, lifts price target
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi cut its rating for Abercrombie & Fitch (NYSE: ANF) to Neutral from Buy on Thursday, saying the retailer's sharp post-earnings rally has left the risk/reward more balanced despite a strong quarter.
